title: Restriction to resolving representatives is fully faithful
statement: Given a full, surjective-on-objects functor p:K→H, a localization q:H→D at a right calculus of fractions W, and full subcategories P and S with P(X) iff S(pX), assume every object of H receives a W-morphism from S. Restriction along (P→K→H→D) squared is fully faithful on functors into any category E.

source.place: Tags 04VI--04VK, localization universal property; application in sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A4

proof.text: Refine Ore squares and cancellation witnesses by resolving their extra vertices. This gives a right calculus of fractions on S.
The localization of S maps fully faithfully to D: refine roofs for fullness and common refinements for faithfulness. Resolving objects proves essential surjectivity.

Precomposition with a localization and its product is fully faithful. Precomposition with a full essentially surjective functor is fully faithful; prove this by transporting components along chosen preimage isomorphisms. Compose these restrictions.

proof_origin.note: Representative descent argument following the cited localization and derived pullback constructions.
